messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — we enter the 1.4.0 code freeze at 17:00 PT today. Hold non-critical merges after 16:30 PT. If you need a late-merge, post PR + short justification here now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jon: Got a docs-only bump (PR #5123). Small changelog tweak. Should I go ahead and land before 16:30? :+1:

maya: Docs-only is fine until 16:30 PT — please add a changelog line and the `docs-only` label so release tooling picks it up.

taylor: Quick question — PR #5188 touches a light DB migration (adds index). Low risk but touches runbooks. Can we request an exception?

maya: For DB changes we require SRE + eng-ops signoff. Please open an exception card (release-exceptions board) with rollback steps and staging smoke results. Link it here once created.

devon: Added staging smoke results and a rollback snippet to the exception card: https://boards/release-exceptions/NEEDID. Also included the cherry-pick command.

devon: ```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b cherry-pick/5188 main
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
# run `./scripts/run-smoke.sh`
```

jon: Reviewing the cherry-pick now, left one tiny nit in the migration comments. If that's fixed, :thumbsup:.

release-bot: Deploy-bot: Reminder — code freeze begins in 45m. Current build queue: 2. Approved exceptions must have `freeze-exception` label and a +1 from SRE.

sam: I'm on SRE duty today, will review the exception card in ~10m. If I approve, @maya please confirm so we can tag and merge.

maya: Thanks @sam — once you +1 I'll add the `freeze-exception` label and coordinate a canary merge window. If we merge, follow the rollback steps and monitor latency dashboards for 15m.

taylor: Filed the exception card and added tests + smoke logs. Tagging @sam and @devon.

sam: Reviewed and +1. Migration runs clean on staging.

maya: Approved. Adding `freeze-exception` label and scheduling merge at T-20m to allow extra CI. Everyone, please avoid any further unrelated pushes to the branch. :lock:

john: (quiet) thanks all — will hold off on my unrelated refactor.

jon: Cherry-pick merged at 16:50 PT, monitor looks stable. Thanks everyone.

release-bot: Deploy-bot: Merge recorded: PR #5188 cherry-picked into release/1.4.0 at 1765432165. Code freeze active.

maya: Closing loop — changelog updated, tag will be cut after the final CI pass. If anything else comes up, open a new exception card and ping here.
